preamble: A palatalized bilabial nasal [mʲ] can lose its labial closure and keep only the palatal component, giving the palatal nasal [ɲ]. This is part of the wider pattern of labial palatalization, in which [pʲ bʲ mʲ] become [c ɟ ɲ]. It is found in Lhasa Tibetan, where the Old Tibetan palatalized onset [mʲ] (written my-) is pronounced [ɲ].

examples.note: The palatalized labial onset (written my-) is pronounced as a palatal nasal in the modern Lhasa language.
